message:
Confirmed! `dwarfstring_constructor` sets `s_data = ""` (the global empty string literal). When `dwarfstring_append` is called with an empty string, it doesn't resize, so `s_data` remains pointing to the global `""`.

Now let me verify the `dwarfstring_append` behavior with an empty string:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>grep -n "dwarfstring_append\b" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libdwarf/src/lib/libdwarf/dwarf_string.c | head -5 && sed -n '100,130p' /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libdwarf/src/lib/libdwarf/dwarf_string.c</｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>grep -n "dwarfstring_append\b" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libdwarf/src/lib/libdwarf/dwarf_string.c | head -5 && sed -n '100,130p' /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libdwarf/src/lib/libdwarf/dwarf_string.c</parameter>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
